groupTours.gate.notInPlanTitle: Group tours are not in your plan
groupTours.gate.notInPlanDescription: Fixed-departure tours with seat bookings and a waitlist are part of a higher plan.
groupTours.gate.offDescription: Switch on group tours in Settings to sell fixed-departure tours with seat bookings.
groupTours.hub.title: Group tours
groupTours.hub.descriptionOff: Tours with set dates, seats left, holds and a waitlist. Nothing changes for custom trips.
groupTours.hub.descriptionOn: Hold times, confirmation, waitlist, passenger fields and what travellers see.
groupTours.hub.switchedOn: Group tours are on. Departures and Tours now appear in the menu.
groupTours.page.title: Group tours
groupTours.page.description: Rules for selling fixed-departure tours: seats, holds, confirmation, the waitlist and what travellers are asked.
groupTours.page.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change these settings. You can read them here.
groupTours.switch.title: Group tours
groupTours.switch.description: Off by default. When off, nothing about group tours appears in the menu.
groupTours.switch.label: Sell fixed-departure group tours
groupTours.switch.hint: Adds Departures and Tours to the menu.
groupTours.seats.title: Seats and holds
groupTours.seats.description: How long a held seat is kept and how big a coach is by default.
groupTours.seats.holdHoursHint: A held seat that is not confirmed in this time is released.
groupTours.seats.vehicleCapacity: Seats in a coach with no size set
groupTours.seats.vehicleCapacityHint: Used when a vehicle has no seating capacity.
groupTours.confirmation.title: Confirmation
groupTours.confirmation.description: When a held booking becomes confirmed.
groupTours.confirmation.modeHint.manual: Staff confirm each booking with a click.
groupTours.confirmation.modeHint.auto_wh: A booking is confirmed at once while seats remain.
groupTours.confirmation.modeHint.on_depo: A booking is confirmed when its deposit is paid.
groupTours.confirmation.markWon: Mark the lead as won on confirmation
groupTours.confirmation.markWonHint: Only moves a lead that is earlier in the pipeline.
groupTours.confirmMode.deposit: Confirm when the deposit is paid
groupTours.waitlist.title: Waitlist
groupTours.waitlist.description: What happens when a departure is full.
groupTours.waitlist.enabled: Keep a waitlist when a departure is full
groupTours.waitlist.suggest: Suggest offering them to the next party
groupTours.waitlist.autoHold: Hold them for the next party automatically
groupTours.rules.title: Booking rules
groupTours.rules.description: Cut-offs, counted back from the first day of the departure.
groupTours.rules.bookingCutoffHint: Tours and departures can override this.
groupTours.rules.extrasCutoffHint: The last day a traveller can add or change extras.
groupTours.passengerFields.title: Passenger fields
groupTours.passengerFields.description: What you ask for each passenger, and whether the booker, the traveller or only staff fill it in.
groupTours.passengerFields.label: Label
groupTours.fields.name: Name
groupTours.rooms.title: Room types
groupTours.rooms.description: The rooms travellers can pick. Supplements are set per tour under Prices.
groupTours.rooms.label: Name
groupTours.rooms.shareMatching: Offer room sharing to solo travellers
groupTours.rooms.shareMatchingHint: The rooming list pairs people who are happy to share, by gender.
groupTours.preferredSeat.title: Preferred seat
groupTours.preferredSeat.label: Travellers can choose a seat
groupTours.preferredSeat.hint: A surcharge can be set per tour under Prices.
groupTours.shown.title: Seats shown to customers
groupTours.shown.description: What public pages show about seats left. Staff always see the numbers.
groupTours.shown.threshold: Few means this many or fewer
groupTours.shown.thresholdHint: Seats left are shown once they drop to this number.
groupTours.deposit.title: Deposit
groupTours.deposit.description: The default deposit for bookings. Tours can override it.
groupTours.terms.title: Public booking terms
groupTours.terms.description: What travellers accept when they book online.
groupTours.terms.textHint: Falls back to the tour's terms, then your itinerary terms.
groupTours.terms.marketingHint: Shows a box travellers can tick to hear from you again.
groupTours.crew.title: Crew
groupTours.crew.driverSeesPassengers: Drivers can see the passenger list
groupTours.crew.driverSeesPassengersHint: When off, drivers see the stops only. Tour leaders always see the passengers.
